molecule_name: Allogeneic Anti-NY-ESO-1-TCR-IL-15-transduced Cord Blood-derived Natural Killer Cells

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: These are genetically modified natural killer cells derived from cord blood, engineered to express a T-cell receptor (TCR) targeting the NY-ESO-1 antigen and interleukin-15 (IL-15) to enhance their anti-tumor activity.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: The cells are engineered to express a TCR specific for the NY-ESO-1 antigen, allowing them to recognize and kill cancer cells expressing this antigen. IL-15 is included to promote NK cell survival and proliferation.

data_notes.record_scope: This record is focused on the investigational cell therapy Allogeneic Anti-NY-ESO-1-TCR-IL-15-transduced Cord Blood-derived Natural Killer Cells.
